ons.name: ONS Public Sector Classification Guide, November 2026 (issued 20 November 2026)

eao.name: The Government Resources and Accounts Act 2000 (Estimates and Accounts) Order 2026, S.I. 2026/216, Schedule
eao.asserts: legal financial accountability: the department whose estimate and accounts include the body (2026-27)

wgao.name: The Whole of Government Accounts (Designation of Bodies) Order 2026, S.I. 2026/66, Schedule

pbd.name: Cabinet Office Public Bodies Directory 2023/24 (published 29 May 2025)

gleif.name: GLEIF Level 2 relationship records (API)

ch.name: Companies House register: persons with significant control (public pages)

eao-ni.name: Estimates and Accounts (Designation of Bodies) Order (Northern Ireland) 2026, S.R. 2026/49

pfi.name: HM Treasury: Current PFI and PF2 projects as at 31 March 2025
